track.title: Afshari: Nahib
track.notes: Open: the suite's finalis is unsettled: Daramads I, II, V vote E, Daramads III, IV, VI, VII vote B, the Forud votes F#. Vote kept.

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C5 and dwells most on C in Nahib. The line peaks at C5 (511.9 Hz) at 0:37.5. It closes on Ek4, not the tonic (C5 → A4 → Bb4 → A4 → A4 → Ek4).
